ES: sin sesgo neto (24h plano), sentado en su propia zona de no-trade -> WAIT.

limite diario de 1000usd ⇒ stop de NQ full ($2220) o GC full ($1310) no caben en 3 intentos: solo caben en micros (MNQ/MGC) si entras.
en: a violent reversal day across all 5: each one swept a fresh extreme and closed in the upper third/near the high.
an open frame conflict in NQ, ES, GC and YM (1h already flipping, 4h hasn't yet); only CL has both frames aligned.
NQ: cleanest. An A+ VAL/PDL 25998-26076 bounce against the 24h -0.52%, but the frame conflict caps the GO -> WAIT.
ES: no net bias (a flat 24h), sitting right inside its own no-trade zone -> WAIT.
GC: a bullish underlying thesis but Asia tends to fade it (a 59% pattern) right after a fresh rejection at yesterday's high; a suspicious R:R -> WAIT.
YM: already accepted above the PDH (the only index to do so) but a frame conflict and a suspicious R:R on the pullback -> WAIT.
CL: a clean breakout with no frame conflict but stretched 9.26 ATR, the most extreme of the night; wait for the pullback -> WAIT.
tomorrow Thursday is Thanksgiving in the US: CME closes the day's RTH, minimal volume; Friday is a short session (Black Friday). Don't expect a normal NY tomorrow.
$1000 daily limit ⇒ a full NQ stop ($2220) or a full GC stop ($1310) don't fit in 3 tries: they only fit as micros (MNQ/MGC) if taken.
